persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Move this candle onto a pale kitchen counter with warm sunlight coming from the upper left. Make the light on the glass and the shadow on the counter match that sunlight, so it looks actually photographed there. Keep the jar and wax the same. Square, no text.
bank.Subject: The candle in its clear glass jar from product-candle.jpg; preserve the jar shape and wax.
bank.New setting: A pale kitchen counter; the rest of the kitchen is your call.
bank.Lighting and shadow direction: Warm sunlight from the upper left, with corresponding glass highlights and a shadow extending toward the lower right.
bank.Style and format: One realistic square photograph at the standard free size, with no added text.

messages.text: Could you take the candle in this pic and move it onto a pale kitchen counter, because I’m trying to picture it in a setting that feels more natural? I always worry that moving a product into a different background will make it look pasted in rather than actually photographed there. Please keep the jar and wax the same, and make the image square with no text. The sunlight should be warm and come from the upper left. I mean that the light on the glass and the shadow on the counter should both match that sunlight, so the candle looks like it was actually photographed on that counter.
